title: Who sees what when you pay for AI

excluded: Per-product exit/escape details (no room in 35 s)

caption: You pay for AI.
But who's *watching?
scenes.visual: A person at a laptop. A coin (payment) and a speech bubble (prompt) pop out and float; four eyes open around the frame and look at the person.

plate.prompt: Dim room of layered paper silhouettes, a single warm glow at the center like a laptop screen, faint shapes of watching eyes in the far background

caption: Two things give you *away:
the *payment
and the *prompt.
scenes.visual: Coin and bubble split onto two dashed lanes labelled PAYMENT (who knows who paid?) and PROMPT (who reads it?).

claims.text: Two things give you away: the payment and the prompt.

caption: On most services,
someone sees *who *paid,
reads *your *prompt,
or *both.
scenes.visual: Coin travels past 'Card or chain' and 'Provider'; bubble past 'Relay', 'Host', 'Model'. An eye opens at each stop and follows it.

claims.text: Payment links requests to an account or wallet; relays and hosts can read prompts

caption: With *Private *Inference:
Aztec hides *who *paid.
Your prompt stays *encrypted
until it's inside a *secure *enclave.
scenes.visual: Coin sinks into Aztec fog (question marks). Bubble gets a padlock, passes CDN and Supplier (closed eyes, 'sees ciphertext'), unlocks inside the glowing enclave.

claims.text: Paid privately on Aztec: payer and amount hidden
CDN, PI and supplier see ciphertext; plaintext only inside the enclave (private mode)

plate.prompt: Soft drifting paper fog on one side, a warm golden glowing box on the other, calm and protective mood

caption: Payer *hidden.
Prompt *hidden.
scenes.visual: Comparison grid, Private Inference row highlighted: payer hidden / prompt hidden for PI, zkAPI, Venice, OpenRouter, AntSeed.

claims.text: Side-by-side table, each product in its most private mode
